assertions.claim: National time-use survey: unpaid work (housework and caring for family) men average 1h52m/day, women 3h29m — a ~1.5-hour gap
assertions.cn_span: 男性每天平均 1 小时 52 分，女性 3 小时 29 分，差了一个半小时

assertions.claim: Participation rates also differ by 16 percentage points
assertions.cn_span: 参与率也差 16 个百分点

assertions.claim: The survey has no marital-status breakdown, so no official number for 'how much housework marriage adds'; the gender gap serves only as an upper bound
assertions.cn_span: 调查没按婚姻状况分组，所以「结了婚家务会多多少」没有官方数字，这个性别差距只能当上限参考

assertions.claim: The division of labor can absolutely be negotiated into something different before registering
assertions.cn_span: 分工完全可以在领证前谈成另一个样子

assertions.claim: 2024 survey: unpaid labor participants average 2h45m/day; participation 67.5% men vs 83.9% women
assertions.cn_span: 无酬劳动（家务、陪伴照料家人等）参与者每日平均 2 小时 45 分，男性 1 小时 52 分、女性 3 小时 29 分，参与率男性 67.5%、女性 83.9%

assertions.claim: Housework 1h17m/day (participants 1h59m, 28 min less than 2018); caring for family 30 min (participants 1h46m)
assertions.cn_span: 居民家务劳动每日平均 1 小时 17 分（参与者 1 小时 59 分，比 2018 年少 28 分），陪伴照料家人 30 分（参与者 1 小时 46 分）
